note: Canóvanas parcels come from CRIM's Catastro Digital (Parcelario, 2018). The CRIM ArcGIS services that publish it (sigejp.pr.gov crim/crim_parcelas, and the satasgis.crimpr.net Parcelas layer named in the CRIM web map) return 'Service not started' or refuse connections; the catastro viewer is a web app with no discoverable open endpoint. No other public parcel service for Canóvanas was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or the pr_geodata WFS.
